comment_regular: DialogMenu click dispatcher. TOPIC tiles select a post-GREETING MenuTopic; INFOGENERAL clears its cached unread byte immediately; clicked Goodbye INFO is parked for close-time commit. Tile ID 4 is the response-skip/continue control: it stops current playback and immediately advances the already-prepositioned response cursor, so skipping the final response reaches INFO processing without waiting for audio or the post-line delay.
